method: Cross-asset removal from main CSS only, using mandatory later entry/selected CSS witnesses. Exact expanded selectors (with original specificity retained through :is/native nesting), or additional leading html ancestor of body in the HTML document. Same property only; no shorthand footprint expansion, lifecycle inference or state removal. Equal/broader numeric px media contexts. Witness wins by important/specificity or mandatory later asset order. Values identical, or basic numeric longhands verified by CSS grammar. No var/env or supports fallback changes.

import_contract.gate: One v2_search3_enabled gate for all four stylesheets and body.search3-candidate. Unconditional foreach inserts all four CSS links once in fixed order.
import_contract.existing_regression: tests/search3_production_presentation_test.py asserts one of each CSS/JS tag, mandatory order and all-or-none canonical/legacy/disabled activation.
import_contract.consumer_scan: rg PHP/HTML/templates found sole tag consumer v2/index.php; no direct partial CSS consumer.

verification.combined_final_selector_property_priorit: equal at every numeric media partition point
verification.nesting: No new rule/group/nesting level; only declarations and empty rules removed

deferred: Whole build/CI handled once by parent batch; no browser or deployment in this pass.
